title: Score first, then bend
statement_md:
Write one ReLU neuron, `neuron(x, w, b)`.

- score `z = w·x + b`
- bend with `max(0, z)`
- return a `float`
- raise `ValueError` when `len(x) != len(w)`

The weights are what training moves; the bend is fixed.
